title: Southern Comfort | KEY.co
description_expanded: Each bedroom in Southern Comfort offers a private retreat, boasting a luxurious bath with ample storage. Relax in the comfort of a plush chair or unwind on a window seat, enjoying moments of solitude. Closets and chests of drawers are available in all bedrooms, ensuring ample space for your belongings. Additionally, each bedroom provides direct access to a small balcony or a large covered porch, inviting you to soak in the picturesque surroundings. All of our properties have internet access. However, we do not and cannot guarantee internet connection or access due to service being provided by an outside third-party vendor, restrictions placed on internet services by personal computers, different connection specifications, and any additional factors that may lead to interruption, failure, or unavailability of internet service. No refunds will be given. Southern Comfort's decor embraces an eclectic melange of well-chosen pieces, inspired by the owner's childhood memories of the French countryside. The richly hued color palette, reminiscent of Matisse's art, adds a touch of elegance. Indulge in the white marble baths, a claw foot tub, the iconic AGA stove, and duvet-clad bedding, evoking a sense of nostalgia and offering a glimpse into a simpler time.
